fields.description: Program Description I. Course Overview 1. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. BIFT divides students into three levels based on their Chinese proficiency: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced, with each level of different classes. 2. Objectives: Beginner Class focuses on basic Chinese knowledge training. Intermediate Class improves reading skills and develops writing skills while consolidating basic Chinese knowledge. Advanced Class guides students to understand Chinese culture more comprehensively and accurately and integrate into Chinese society while further consolidating and improving listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. 3. Duration: One semester/One year 4. Curriculum: A combination of listening and speaking courses and comprehensive courses will be used to teach the Chinese language systematically. At the same time, Chinese culture study tours or extracurricular language practice activities will be arranged on irregular basis. II. Class Duration According to students' number, each semester has 16 to 20 weeks and each week has 12 to 20 class hours. Customized courses regarding study tour and exchange projects are set up according to actual needs.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.docx). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write "None" if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. * 2. A recent electronic ID photo with a white background * 3. Passport -A clear, full-color scan of your passport information page, showing your name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. -Some universities may also require blank visa pages, so you are advised to upload a few blank pages as well. * 4. Please provide a Chinese name Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. In principle, applicants should be non-Chinese citizens between the ages of 18 and 50 complying with the relevant provisions of the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and hold a valid foreign passport. 2. Applicants should be of good character, in good health, abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and BIFT's discipline, and respect Chinese customs.
